{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) to counteract overconfidence.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent 7-day mean reversion is strong (true outcome > model forecast by > 3σ).",
    "Increase forecast lag by 1-2 days if model shows sharp upward spikes (e.g., > +15% from prior day) without sentiment support.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction: if model forecast is > 20% above 30-day moving average, reduce by 15-25%.",
    "When sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0.00), allow slight overshoot but cap forecast at +10% above recent 7-day high to avoid overcorrection.",
    "For low volatility periods (std dev < 2.5% over 30d), reduce forecast variance by 30% to avoid noise amplification.",
    "If true outcome consistently exceeds model forecast by > 5% over 3 consecutive days, apply a 10% downward bias correction for next forecast."
  ]
}
